comments.content: You're free to start, not sure why the bot is not responding

There is the [NftReward](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/f3aff74902c9c9814bdb0ffb1c213fbe7cba9360/src/NftReward.sol) contract responsible for minting NFTs using a minter's signature. We should make the contract to be upgradeable.
What should be done:
1. Make [NftReward](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/f3aff74902c9c9814bdb0ffb1c213fbe7cba9360/src/NftReward.sol) contract upgradeable (using openzeppelin's [UUPS contracts](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/5.x/api/proxy#UUPSUpgradeable))
2. Update the [deployment script](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/f3aff74902c9c9814bdb0ffb1c213fbe7cba9360/script/Deploy001_NftReward.s.sol)
It's better to keep all remappings in a single place, either here (in the `foundry.toml`) either [here](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/development/remappings.txt)
What's the purpose of adding the `lib/openzeppelin-foundry-upgrades` submodule if we don't use it?
Shouldn't we also disable initializers (https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/1.x/writing-upgradeable#initializing_the_implementation_contract)?

comments.content: Pls refactor the test to use the proxy, the same way as implemented in the deployment script
@gpylypchuk Since we don't use https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-foundry-upgrades anymore do we need this settings (`build_info`, `extra_output`)?

Pls make sure there is 1 reference to the standard OZ lib and 1 ref to the upgradeable one. Right now there are 3 refs to the standard OZ lib and 1 ref to the upgradeable one [here](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/3a87e51b18c82730b96459a3eff5149e1c7122f9/remappings.txt).
Shouldn't we use https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/blob/master/contracts/utils/PausableUpgradeable.sol?
@gpylypchuk I don't understand why was the hash updated if the signed data is untouched?
This comment is ambiguous because it does not match the asserted hash, pls update or remove

Answering my own question, hash has changed because sender's nonce is used on smart contract address computation which is a part of EIP721. This PR adds more transactions in the test file, hence some other nonce is used, hence the hash is different.
Don't we need to call https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts-upgradeable/blob/5dd8d5960d7a7a00271a38716807ff420747c602/contracts/utils/PausableUpgradeable.sol#L56 here?

Right now there are 3 references to a standard OZ lib ([one](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/4571c4a2fee22fbf07bda9a643c8ea85e37210d5/remappings.txt#L1), [two](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/4571c4a2fee22fbf07bda9a643c8ea85e37210d5/remappings.txt#L5), [three](https://github.com/ubiquity/nft-rewards/blob/4571c4a2fee22fbf07bda9a643c8ea85e37210d5/remappings.txt#L6)).
1. Don't your IDE show errors that `@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable` is missing?
2. Pls make sure there is only 1 reference to the standard OZ lib and only 1 reference to the upgradeable one.
